from.name: TCP learned metrics stored in route/destination metrics

property: Linux moves computed dynamic TCP metrics out of route metrics into a dedicated destination-keyed local TCP metrics hash/cache, later consolidating timestamp memory there as well.

date_or_range.notes: Architecture split documented by the dedicated tcp_metrics cache commits.

sources.supports: computed TCP metrics no longer maintained in route metrics; dedicated local cache introduced
timestamps moved from inetpeer into metrics cache

negative_claims: This does not mean routing metrics as a general concept disappeared.
The dedicated TCP metrics cache is cross-connection path memory, not live per-socket TCP_INFO state.
open_questions: Trace the older route-cache/route-metrics TCP memory implementation to its first introduction.
notes: Architecture split between routing state and learned TCP path memory.
